sources: National Institute of Korean Language, Korean Basic Dictionary, 같이¹ (adverb), ParaWordNo=26799. https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=26799
National Institute of Korean Language, Korean Basic Dictionary, 같이² (particle), ParaWordNo=22776. https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=22776
claims: 같이 has an adverbial use meaning together/with and also a similarity sense, so its interpretation depends on the construction.
In combinations such as 친구와 같이, the comitative-marked noun and adverb 같이 jointly express accompanying participation.
The article correctly distinguishes the adverbial companionship use from other uses of 같이 rather than treating 같이 as a single Spanish-style preposition.
entry.notes: Auditoría R44 de MLS-V08-0731: PASS_NO_CHANGE. La explicación de 같이 como adverbio de compañía/participación conjunta en construcciones como 친구와 같이 es correcta, y la advertencia sobre el valor comparativo también coincide con la lexicografía oficial. Los ejemplos son naturales y no requieren corrección editorial. R33 canónico permanece PENDING_CANONICAL_R33_VALIDATION.

sources: National Institute of Korean Language, Korean Basic Dictionary, 마다, ParaWordNo=70331. https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=70331&nation=eng
claims: 마다 marks every member of a set without exception and can also express recurrence at each time interval.
Forms such as 사람마다 and 주말마다 support the article's distinction between distribution over members and recurrence over periods.
The article correctly notes that 마다 identifies the units of distribution rather than specifying the quantity assigned to each unit.
entry.notes: Auditoría R44 de MLS-V08-0733: PASS_NO_CHANGE. La entrada describe correctamente 마다 como marcador distributivo y recurrente equivalente con frecuencia a «cada». La aplicación a personas, lugares y periodos temporales es adecuada, y el contraste didáctico con 씩 es útil y correcto. R33 canónico permanece PENDING_CANONICAL_R33_VALIDATION.

sources: National Institute of Korean Language, Korean Basic Dictionary, -씩 (suffix), dictionary search. https://krdict.korean.go.kr/jpn/dicMarinerSearch/search?mainSearchWord=%EC%94%A9&nation=jpn&nationCode=7
National Institute of Korean Language, Korean Basic Dictionary, examples with 다섯 명씩, ParaWordNo=60628. https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=60628&nation=eng
National Institute of Korean Language, Korean Basic Dictionary, examples with 한 명씩, ParaWordNo=52752. https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=52752&nation=eng
claims: The Korean Basic Dictionary classifies -씩 as a suffix (접사) whose core distributive sense divides or repeats the preceding quantity or amount.
Expressions such as 한 명씩 and 다섯 명씩 illustrate distribution by repeated quantity or count.
The article itself does not misclassify 씩 as a particle and accurately explains its contrast with 마다 in terms of quantity/portion versus distributive unit.
entry.notes: Auditoría R44 de MLS-V08-0734: PASS_NO_CHANGE. La función distributiva de 씩 está descrita correctamente y los ejemplos 한 장씩, 한 명씩, 두 개씩 y 한 시간씩 son coherentes. La fuente oficial clasifica -씩 como 접사 (sufijo), no como 조사; el cuerpo de la entrada no afirma que sea una partícula, por lo que no hay un error factual que corregir. El nombre del capítulo es organización editorial, no una afirmación morfológica dentro del artículo. R33 canónico permanece PENDING_CANONICAL_R33_VALIDATION.

claims: 에게서 attaches to a person or animate referent and marks the source from which an action, transfer, information, or learning originates.
Dictionary argument patterns for 받다 and 배우다 explicitly license 에게서 as a source marker.
The article correctly contrasts source-oriented 에게서 with recipient/direction-oriented 에게 and appropriately mentions colloquial 한테서.
entry.notes: Auditoría R44 de MLS-V08-0735: PASS_NO_CHANGE. La entrada caracteriza correctamente 에게서 como marcador de procedencia/origen personal y sus ejemplos con 받다, 듣다, 배우다 y correo de un remitente son compatibles con el uso estándar. El contraste con 에게 y la mención de 한테서 son adecuados. R33 canónico permanece PENDING_CANONICAL_R33_VALIDATION.

sources: National Institute of Korean Language, Korean Basic Dictionary, 처럼, ParaWordNo=68275. https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=68275
National Institute of Korean Language, Korean Basic Dictionary, 같이² (particle), ParaWordNo=22776. https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=22776
claims: 처럼 follows a nominal expression and marks similarity in form, degree, manner, or other comparable property.
Translations such as como/igual que are appropriate while the construction expresses resemblance rather than identity.
The article correctly relates 처럼 to comparative 같이 while warning that 같이 also has a companionship use and is not universally interchangeable.
entry.notes: Auditoría R44 de MLS-V08-0736: PASS_NO_CHANGE. La explicación de 처럼 como marcador de semejanza es correcta; los ejemplos con modo de hablar, color, manera de reír y trato comparativo son naturales. La distinción entre semejanza e identidad y la comparación con 같이 están bien formuladas. R33 canónico permanece PENDING_CANONICAL_R33_VALIDATION.
